features: Bluetooth – Stream your music library from your smartphone or MP3 player plus use apps such as Spotify and Pandora. Pair it to your SMART tv without the hastles of wires.
Aux-The Aux Input allows you to connect to the audio output of an external device such as an MP3 Player or Smartphone or PC or Laptop or TV so you can enjoy your music through your system.

FM- Listen to FM radio stations and store your favorites for quick access. Change them at will. Open up & peel the end of the antenna wire on the back to enhance the range and clarity of the transmission

Remote and Controls-Scan, pause, play, select previous and next music file, Search forwards and backwards, auto search FM radio stations, turn the volume up and down via the wireless remote or controls located on the subwoofer box
Equalizer -The system has 4 preset equalizer modes that you can toggle between. Each mode will offer different parameters so as to enhance they type of tones produced
